highlights: Earn up to 3 miles per dollar on online transactions from transportation, grocery, and food delivery merchants, capped at S$1,000 spend per statement month. You can also earn 2 miles per dollar on online grocery purchases (capped at S$1,000 per statement month) and 1.2 miles per dollar on any local spending. Transportation, food delivery and online grocery rewards capped at 3,000 miles in a statement cycle.
pros: Earn 3 miles for every S$1 spent on online transactions from transportation, food delivery, and online grocery merchants.
pros: Earn 2 miles for every S$1 on foreign currency transactions.
pros: Earn 1.2 miles for every S$1 spent locally.
pros: 2 complimentary visits to Priority Pass lounges around the world each year.
pros: Get peace of mind when you travel with complimentary travel insurance coverage of up +to S$500,000.
pros: Rewards points do not expire.
pros: Flexible redemption – enjoy your choice of air miles, cash rewards or travel vouchers on the SCB Rewards 360 platform.

pros: SC Shop and Earn - Book your holidays and earn up to 28.75% Cashback at over 40 travel partners like Agoda, Klook, Trip.com. Unlock one of the highest Cashback as a Priority client. Log on to SC Shop and Earn via SC Mobile to start shopping.

pros: Get access to exclusive card offers and privileges with 
The Good Life
 programme.
cons: Transportation, food delivery and online grocery rewards capped at 3,000 miles in a statement cycle.

sign_up_offers.terms:
SingSaver Exclusive Offer promotion is valid from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new Standard Chartered credit cardmembers only.
Apply for the Standard Chartered Journey Card and make a min. spend of S$800 within 60 days of card approval date, plus 
any 
of the following SCB products to be eligible for reward:
Apply for 
Standard Chartered EasyPay
 for at least 3 retail transactions on your credit card with min. amount of S$150 each and min. tenure of 12 months (within 60 days of card approval date); or
Apply and open a 
Standard Chartered Bonus$aver Account
 with a min. deposit of S$3,000 (within 60 days of card approval date) (quick apply 
here
); or
Apply and get approved for a 
Standard Chartered CashOne Personal Loan
 with min. amount of S$1,000 and min. tenure of 12 months (within 60 days of card approval date) (quick apply 
here
); or
Apply and get approved for a 
Standard Chartered Credit Card Funds Transfer (CCFT)
 with min. amount of S$1,000 and min. tenure of 3 months (within 60 days of card approval date) (quick apply 
here
)
Apply for at least 
3 EasyPay retail transactions
 on your credit card, each with min. amount of S$150 and min. tenure of 12 months, within 60 days of card approval. Application must be made via the SCB App.
Promotion is stackable with welcome offer from Standard Chartered (
T&Cs apply

Receive up to 30,000 miles

citation.title: Standard Chartered Journey Credit Card (Annual Fee Paying)

extra.description: The newly rebranded Standard Chartered Journey Credit Card allows you to earn 3 miles per dollar on local online transactions, such as transportation, grocery and food delivery merchants. Other local spend earns you 1.2 miles per dollar while oversea spends nets you 2 miles per dollar. Your miles never expire, and you'll also enjoy 2 complimentary Priority Pass airport lounge access per year.
